fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM79,910. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0056488/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Pass in Mathematics at SPM level AND at least a C (2.00 CGPA) in two (2) subjects at STPM level; OR Jayyid in STAM; OR Matriculation/Foundation/Pre-U/Diploma/UEC with at least 2.00 CGPA or equivalent. International students must score at least 5.5 in IELTS or equivalent.
